spots.name: Albuquerque Museum
spots.price: Free Sun 9 a.m.–1 p.m.; tickets other times
spots.blurb: Art and history of the Southwest next to Old Town; open Tuesday to Sunday
spots.blurbEs: Arte e historia del suroeste junto a Old Town; abre de martes a domingo

spots.name: ABQ BioPark Zoo
spots.blurb: 64-acre zoo by the Rio Grande with polar bears, penguins and a Mexican wolf pack
spots.blurbEs: Zoológico de 64 acres junto al río Grande con osos polares, pingüinos y una manada de lobos mexicanos

spots.name: ABQ BioPark Botanic Garden
spots.blurb: Gardens, a desert conservatory and a heritage farm along the river
spots.blurbEs: Jardines, un invernadero desértico y una granja histórica junto al río

spots.name: Petroglyph National Monument
spots.blurb: Short trails past thousands of ancient rock carvings; closed only Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year’s Day
spots.blurbEs: Senderos cortos entre miles de grabados rupestres antiguos; cierra solo en Acción de Gracias, Navidad y Año Nuevo

spots.name: Sandia Peak Tramway
spots.blurb: Aerial tram up the Sandia Mountains with huge views over the city
spots.blurbEs: Teleférico a las montañas Sandía con enormes vistas sobre la ciudad
